articles.summary: Clinicians set the standard for every answer Vera gives. Here is how we built AI judges that grade Vera's answers the way a panel of clinicians would, and what they taught us about the errors that matter most.
articles.title: How we taught AI to grade like a panel of clinicians

articles.summary: With a team of just 12 employees, Vera Health has grown largely through physician referrals to more than 800,000 clinicians in 190 countries, bringing total funding to $32 million.
articles.title: Vera Health Quietly Became One of the World's Most Used Clinical Tools. Now It Has Raised $32 Million

articles.summary: We put 100 real point-of-care questions from the Real-POCQi study to Vera, OpenEvidence and three frontier AI models, and graded every pair blind on six measures, including clinical accuracy.
articles.title: How does Vera compare with frontier AI labs on the questions doctors really ask?
